#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstring>

int distinctColors(const std::vector<int>& arr, int start, int end) {
    bool seenColors[24];
    std::memset(seenColors, false, sizeof(seenColors));
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = start; i <= end; i++) {
        int color = arr[i];
        if (!seenColors[color]) {
            seenColors[color] = true;
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int a, b, l, r;
    std::cin >> a >> b >> l >> r;
    l -= 1;
    r -= 1;

    int totalSegments = a + b;
    int repeatCount = 4;
    std::vector<int> patternArray(totalSegments * repeatCount, 0);

    int segmentShift = l / totalSegments;
    l -= segmentShift * totalSegments;
    r -= segmentShift * totalSegments;

    int segmentSize = (r - l + 1) / totalSegments;
    if (segmentSize > 2) {
        r -= (segmentSize - 2) * totalSegments;
    }

    int diffVal = (a > b) ? (a - b) : 1;

    for (int rep = 0; rep < repeatCount; rep++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < a - diffVal; k++)
            patternArray[(a + b) * rep + k] = k;
        for (int k = 0; k < diffVal; k++)
            patternArray[(a + b) * rep + a - diffVal + k] = (rep % 2 == 0) ? (a - diffVal + k) : (a + k);
    }

    int minColorsCount = a + a;

    for (int shiftA = 1; shiftA <= diffVal; shiftA++) {
        for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
            patternArray[(a + b) * 0 + a + k] = patternArray[(a + b) * 0 + a - shiftA];
        for (int shiftB = 1; shiftB <= diffVal; shiftB++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                patternArray[(a + b) * 1 + a + k] = patternArray[(a + b) * 1 + a - shiftB];
            for (int shiftC = 1; shiftC <= diffVal; shiftC++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                    patternArray[(a + b) * 2 + a + k] = patternArray[(a + b) * 2 + a - shiftC];
                for (int k = 0; k < b; k++)
                    patternArray[(a + b) * 3 + a + k] = patternArray[(a + b) * 3 + a - shiftC];
                minColorsCount = std::min(minColorsCount, distinctColors(patternArray, l, r));
            }
        }
    }
    std::cout << minColorsCount << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
